welcome: Hello, little duck. The giants are sleeping. Let's find their dreams. Press any button when you’re ready.
Shh. Everyone's asleep but us. Ready to go dream-hunting? Press any button when you’re ready.
Welcome back, little duck. The night is soft and waiting. Press any button when you’re ready.
find_dreamling: A dream is glowing nearby. Can you go touch it?
dream_home: Home again. The giant sighs, warm and glad.
Look at that — safe and snug. One more dream tucked in.
There. The fort glows a little brighter now.
Well carried, little duck. That dream is home.
well_done: You found them all. The giant smiles in their sleep.
Every dream is home. Listen — can you hear it purring?
All tucked in. This whole place is glad you came.
new_area: A new place to explore. Let's see what's waiting.
Ooh. Somewhere new. Stay close, and let's look around.
Here we are. Quiet now — someone big is sleeping here.
paused: Taking a little rest. I'll wait right here.
Pause whenever you like. I'm not going anywhere.
goodnight: Goodnight, little duck. Sweet dreams until next time.
Off to bed. I'll keep watch till you're back.
Sleep well. The giants will still be dreaming tomorrow.
callie_dreams: Callie dreams of being big someday.
Even Callie curls up small and dreams enormous dreams.
mission_race: Someone's feeling quick today. Think you can keep up?
A little race, just for fun. Nobody loses this one.
mission_ride: Climb on. Some dreams are easier to carry together.
Hold tight, little duck. This one likes to travel.
mission_shy: This one's shy. Go slow, and let it come to you.
Careful now — soft steps. Shy dreams startle easy.
mission_duet: This dream needs two. Lucky you brought a friend.
Together now — one of you won't be enough for this.
move_flutter_first: Ooh! Your onesie catches the air. Try that again.
Look at you flutter. Little duck, you can float.
move_glide_first: Now you're gliding. Slow and soft, like a falling leaf.
Arms out — there you go. That's flying, almost.
move_pound_first: What a thump! Did you feel that bounce?
Down you go — and up someone else pops. Nicely done.
world_complete: This whole place is dreaming happily now, because of you.
Everything here is settled and sound. You did that.
fort_grows_5: Five dreams home now. Listen — the fort is humming.
The fort's getting fuller. Can you feel it glowing?
fort_grows_10: Ten dreams home. The whole fort is warm with them.
Look how big it's grown. All because you kept going.
rescue: Whoops — up you float. Falling's just another way to land.
Gotcha. Soft as a pillow, safe as anything.
No trouble at all, little duck. Up and onward.
bramble_d01_race: Ready, little duck? This one loves a good chase.
bramble_d02_race: Another quick one — keep up if you can.
bramble_d03_ride: Hold tight. This one likes slow, lazy loops.
bramble_d04_open: This one's happy right where it is.
bramble_d05_ride: Climb on, little duck — this dream loves to drift.
bramble_d06_open: Look — it naps on the bear's own breath.
bramble_d07_geyser: Careful — this dream rides the bear's own snore.
bramble_d08_duet: This dream needs two, little duck. Bring your friend.
bramble_d09_shy: Shh — go slow. This one startles easily.
bramble_d10_open: Tucked in close, right by the door home.
wisp_d01_race: This dream loves to race along the shore.
wisp_d09_shy: Slow down, little duck — this reed-dream is shy.
marmalade_d01_race: Someone's quick today, right through the village square.
marmalade_d09_shy: Careful now — this one hides among the pots.
tortoise_d01_race: Ready, little duck? This dream loves a slow, sunny chase.
tortoise_d04_ride: Climb aboard — this one drifts like pollen on the breeze.
tortoise_d05_duet: This dream needs two, right here in her garden.
tortoise_d07_bloom: Careful — this dream naps right on her slow breath.
tortoise_d08_shy: Shh — go slow. This one hides among the clover.
door_ready: That glowing door remembers a giant. Press your talk button to knock.
A door! Doors love a little press of the hands.
This door leads somewhere sleepy. Give it a press when you're ready.
waking_dawn: Look up, little ducks. The sky is getting soft. You brought every single dream home.
waking_giants: Listen. All of them, dreaming happily. The whole night is tucked in.
waking_sleepy: And now... it's somebody else's bedtime. Come here, you two.
waking_goodnight: The nap holds. Goodnight, little dreamers. Goodnight.
fort_home: Back at the fort, little duck. Everyone kept your spot warm.
Home again. The blankets missed you.
There's the fort. Softest place in the whole night.
keystone_rollover: Shhh. Just rolling over. Still fast asleep.
